localContent:
EXTREME close world-coordinate CROP of the existing SOUTH CITY WALL, never a whole building, city view or road. Reconstruct native painted stone detail from the last target's mapped forms; never reproduce its pixel grid. Keep exactly the orthographic wall-plane framing and large masonry block scale. Warm neutral pale limestone, subtle grain and crisp narrow mortar joints, lightly beveled edges, soft daylight. No decorative blue paving bands, windows, doors, glyphs, ornaments, trees, rooftops or new props. Preserve and smoothly continue every sharp native anchor contour and color; x230/y230 anchor borders are not object outlines. No invented image-border frames or extra rows of tiny bricks. Bottom course of existing south city wall. Narrow pale stone ledge along y0..145; darker grey stone foundation blocks y145..565, horizontal recessed joint and slim light bevel around y570..720; lower grey stone base down to y1139, with partial green wall-side ground foliage entering lower-left. Green regions are only partial attached low foliage in mapped positions; no pots/whole tree. Last-target black strip y1139..1254 is OUTSIDE formal canvas geometry guide, NOT artwork: paint a natural short continuation of adjacent base/foliage through every pixel, opaque no black border, no extra panorama.
CRITICAL SEAM CONTINUITY: Every visible vertical mortar joint in the sharp top anchor must continue downward until it physically meets the next complete horizontal mortar course, and every horizontal joint in the left anchor must extend across the new area. Never truncate, fade or bend mortar at x230/y230. Sharp native-anchor topology and scale outrank blurred layout joint estimates. Join the actual neighboring block edges with natural masonry T-junctions. Maintain anchor material color, brightness and texture size all the way across. No apparent material boundary at the guide-strip edges.
